explication: NetFluss is a native macOS menu-bar and Windows taskbar network monitor. Its main workflow samples interface traffic, presents live rates and related network context, and lets users open statistics, speed testing, Network Slice, router monitoring, and VPN features. The graph keeps platform implementations distinct while showing their shared product capabilities. Edges are limited to relationships visible in the README or SOURCE INDEX; several unsampled feature implementations are represented by their exact enclosing directories, so their internal call paths are not asserted.
